column1: # FEWS NET / IPC — countries with populations in IPC Phase 3 or worse
# SOURCE   https://fews.net/  and  https://www.ipcinfo.org/
# CADENCE  Monthly-ish; FEWS NET publishes country updates continuously and IPC
#          releases analyses as they are completed.
# VALUE    Number of countries with a population in IPC/CH Phase 3 (Crisis) or
#          above. Lower is better.
# HOW TO UPDATE
#   1. Open the IPC country analyses map at ipcinfo.org.
#   2. Count countries with any population in Phase 3+ in the current period.
#   3. Append: <YYYY-MM>-01
#   4. Run: npm run data:refresh
# WHY THIS IS MANUAL
#   FEWS NET has no public JSON API. It publishes shapefiles and per-country PDF
#   reports; the IPC has a data portal but its API requires a key issued by
#   request and its coverage is analysis-by-analysis rather than a world series.
#   Neither offers "countries in Phase 3+ this month" as a queryable figure —
#   it is a count someone has to make from the map.
#   If this becomes worth automating
